result.title: Radar-Based 3D Human Pose Estimation via Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement
result.summary: 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) is used in indoor environments, such as smart homes, to analyze human movement and monitor human states. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar is suitable for this task because it is robust to lighting variations and does not capture images of human appearance. However, radar observations often provide insufficient information about certain body parts or contain overlapping reflections from multiple body parts, limiting accurate 3D joint localization. To address these limitations, we propose the Initialization-to-Refinement Pose Framework (I2R-Pose), comprising two stages: Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement. In the first stage, joint-wise features are learned by incorporating temporal relationships across consecutive radar observations and human skeletal structure to compensate for insufficient joint information and estimate an initial 3D pose sequence. In the second stage, separately extracted radar observation features predict joint-wise positional corrections that refine the initial pose and generate the final pose sequence. The framework supports individual and fused inputs of time-Doppler/time-range (TD/TR) maps and radar point clouds (PCs). To evaluate performance across indoor activities, we construct the Radar Motion and Spatial Information for 3D Human Pose Estimation (RaMoS-Pose) dataset, providing synchronized TD/TR maps, radar PCs, and 3D joint ground truth (GT). Evaluations on RaMoS-Pose and the publicly available MVDoppler-Pose dataset show that I2R-Pose reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 39.50% on MVDoppler-Pose and by 15.13% on RaMoS-Pose with fused inputs, compared with the best-performing existing methods evaluated on each dataset.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 I2R-Pose 两阶段框架用于毫米波雷达 3D 人体姿态估计：第一阶段结合连续观测的时序关系与人体骨架结构学习关节级特征并初始化姿态序列，第二阶段用独立提取的雷达观测特征预测关节位置修正量，同时构建并发布了 RaMoS-Pose 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先由先验与结构生成粗状态、再以观测特征做残差修正」的两阶段流程，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态如何被视觉证据逐步校正、以及证据贡献如何分配提供类比线索，但领域相隔较远，需核查修正阶段是否真正依赖具体观测证据而非单纯回归。
